paite: Huaiziak in Israelte aw, TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon piak gam, dam a na luahtheihna ding ua na zuih ding uh ka hon hilh dante leh vaihawmte ngaikhia un.
heading: Mosi In Thumang Ding In Israel Akun

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak ka hon piak na zuihtheihna ding un, ka hon thupiak na behlap ding uh ahi kei a, na kiamsak ding uh leng ahi sam kei.
Baal-peor a TOUPA thilhih na mit un na mu ua; Baal-peor bemi tengteng TOUPA na Pathian un na lak ua pan ahihmangta hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh lenkip peuhmahte bel tutan in dam in a-om lai chiat uhi.
Ngai un, na va luah ding gam ua leng na zuih zel ding un TOUPA ka Pathian in thu ahon piak bang geih in dante leh vaihawmte ka hon hilh hi.

Hiai dan leh dan thuseh tengteng za a, "Hiai nam thupi, apil leh atheisiam mite ahi taktak uh," chi ding namte kiang a hiai in na pilna uh leh na theihsiamna uh lak ding ahih ziak in pilvangtak in hiaite zui un.
I sap peuhmah chiang ua TOUPA i Pathian in ahon naih bang a amau naih zel pathian nei nam thupi kua a-om ua?
Hichitak a dik, dan leh vaihawmna, tua na ma ua ka khun tengteng bang dan nei nam thupi dang kua a-om a?

Bang teng hi heh, pilvang unla, ngenteltak in kikem phot un. Huchi lou in zaw na mit un athil muhte na mangngilh ding ua, na damsung un na lungtang ua pan amang kha ding hi. Na tate uh leh na tute uh sinsak un.

Horeb tang a TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a na din ua, TOUPA'N ka kiang a, "Mite hon sapkhawmsak in, leitung a a-om sung teng ua hon kihtakdan akisintheihna ding uh leh atate uh sinsak ding in ka thute ka hon zasak ding, ahon chih ni na mangngilh kha ding uhi," achi hi.
Huchi in na hong naih ua, huai tangbul ah na hong dingh uhi. Huai lai in meikuang in van sun zen in huai tang akang a, meipi vom leh mial in akhuh lai hi.
TOUPA'N meikuang a pan ahon houpih a; athugen na za ua, himahleh lim bangmah na mu kei ua, aw ging lel na za uhi.
Athukhun zui dia nou thu ahon piak, thupiak sawm na kiang uah agenkhia a, suangpek nih ah agelh hi.
Huai lai in luah dia na va galkahna gam ua na zuih ding un dante leh vaihawmte sinsak ding in TOUPA'N thu ahon pia hi.
Huaiziak in pilvang mahmah un. Horeb tang a meikuang a pan TOUPA'N nou hon houpih ni in lim bangmah na mu kei uhi.
heading: Milim Biakna Thu A Vauna

paite: Nou leh nou kihihsia in, milim gelh kibawl in, lim kibatpih, apa lim hiam, anu lim hiam,
leitung a om gamsa kibatpih, huihkhua a leng kha nei vasa kibatpih,
lei a vak thilte kibatpih, lei nuai a tui a om ngasa mawngmawng kibatpih na kibawl kha ding uhi.
Van lam na nga un, ni, kha, aksite, van a om tengteng leng na mu un, TOUPA na Pathian un van nuai a mi tengteng ahon sehsakte un hon hip in, hiaite bia in a-nna uh na sepsak kha ding uh.
TOUPA'N amite, agou hi ding in sik haltuina a pan, Aigupta gam a pan nou ahon pikhe zawta ahi; tu a na hih mah bang un.
Hiai kia leng hilou in, noute ziak in ka tung ah TOUPA aheh a, Jordan lui ka galkah louh a, na luah ding ua gam hoihtak TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak a ka lutlouhna ding in leng akichiam hi.
Kei zaw hiai gam a si ding ka hi a, Jordan lui gal kah lou ding ka hi. Nou bel na galkah ding ua, hiai gam hoihtak na luah ding uhi,
Pilvang mahmah un, TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun, na kiang ua akhun na mangngilh ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un akibatpih himhim bawl aphal louh milimte na kibawltawm kha mahmah ding uh.
TOUPA na Pathian uh katmang hat mei, mullit hat Pathian ahi.

Tu leh tate na neih ua, huai gam a sawt kuam na ten nung ua, na kineksiat louh ua, banghiam akibatpih peuh a milim bawltawm lelte na bawlkhiak ua, hihheh dia TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih maizen uleh;

Jordan kan a na va luah ding uh gam a pan na mangthang pah ding uh, chih na tungtang thu ua hon theihpih ding in tu in lei leh van ka chial ahi. Sawt na teng kei ding ua, na mangthang vek mai ding uh.
TOUPA'N mite lak ah hon dalhsak dia, TOUPA'N hon paimangsakna namte lak ah tawmchik kia na teng ding uh.
Huai ah, sing leh suang a abawl uh pathiante, mu thei lou peuh, za thei lou peuh, ne thei lou peuh, dik thei lou peuh na be ding uh.
Himahleh huai lai mah a TOUPA na Pathian uh na zon ua, na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua na zon uleh na mu ding uh.
Haksa a na om ua, na tung ua hiai thil tengteng ahong tun chiang in, TOUPA na Pathian uh lam na hong nga khongkhong ding ua, athu na zuita ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh lah zahngaihna a dim Pathian ahi ngal a; ahon donsak lou kei dia, ahon hihmang kei ding. Na pi-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a athukhun amangngilh het kei ding hi.
Na om ma uh, nidanglaite sui le uchin leitung a Pathian in mihing asiam nungsiah van nuai ah, hichibang a thil thupi a-om ngei in, zak ahi ngei hia?
Na zak bang un, mei a pan Pathian aw mi'n aza ngei mawngmawng in, ahing uhia?

Namdang lak a pan khemna, chiamtehna, thillamdang, kidouna, khut hattak, ban zak, thil mulkimhuai a TOUPA na Pathian un na mitmuh ua Aigupta gam a ahih tengteng bang a nam pikhe ngam Pathian a-om ngei hia?
TOUPA amah tuh Pathian ahi, chih na theihtheihna ding ua na kiang ua hihlat ahi a; amah lou ngal adang a-om kei.
Ahon sinsak theihna ding in van a pan a-aw hon zasak a, leitung ah ameikuang thupi ahon musak a, meikuang a pan athu na za uhi.
Na pi-le-pute uh a-it ziak in anung ua asuante uh ahon tel a, amitmuh in athilhihtheihna thupitak in Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia hi.
Namdang nou sang a thupi leh thilhihtheizaw ahon delhkhiaksak a, agam uh hon luahsak a, tua na hih mah bang un hon lutsak hi.
Huaiziak in tu in na lungtang un vom unla, tunglam van ah leh nuailam lei ah TOUPA zaw Pathian ahi, chih thei un. Adang himhim kuamah a-om kei hi.
Tangtawn a dia TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon piak gam ah noumau leh na suante uh a dia hoih ding leh na ten sawttheihna ding un, adante leh athupiakte, tua ka hon piakte na zuih ding uh ahi.
Huchi in Mosi in Jordan gal, nisuahna lam pang ah khopi thum asep hi.
heading: Jordan Suahlam A Kihumbitna Khopite

paite: Tualthatmi, a-invengte, tuma lam a leng mudah khol lou, mi that kha humbitna ding in, hiai khua khatpeuh peuh a, atailutleh humbit in a-om ding.
Huai khuate hiaite ahi uh: Reubente gam a Bezer khopi; Gadte gam Gilead a Ramoth khopi leh Manassehte gam Bashan a Golan ahi uhi.
Mosi in Israel suante apiak, dan hiai ahi.
heading: Pathian Dan Piak Putlakna

paite: Hiaite Mosi piak theihsaknate, dan thusehte leh dante ahi. Huai bel Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai uleh,

Sihon gam, Jordan lui suahlam a Beth-peor kiang phaizang a, a-om lai ua apiak ahi. Sihon bel Amorte kumpipa, Heshbon a vaihawmpa, Mosi leh Israelte'n Aigupta a pan ahong paikhiak lai ua azohpa uh ahi.
Amau Sihon gam leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam aluah uhi. Amau nihte Jordan lui suahlam a Amor kumpipa nihte ahi uhi.
Hiai gam ahihleh Arnon Phaizang gei a Aroer a pan Sion tang, Hermon leng achih uh, pha a kizalh ahi. Sion tang in min dang anei a, Hermon ahi.
Huai gam in Jordan lui suahlam a Arabah luipiau tengteng, Pisgah tang a tui nakte nuai a Arabah tuipi tan ahuap hi.
